effect_quotas.note: copies of each typed gear effect per observed near-complete roster (>= 10 recorded seats); display-only until graded

carrier_quotas.note: carrier caps and floors per effect x style x band from one coverage-corrected measurement of the killer rosters of 10+; the engine caps a generated roster at max(floor, max(1, round-half-up(share x size))) and dresses it to its floor (GENERATION only)
carrier_quotas.unit: one distinct fully-known killer roster of 10+ (guild set + weapon multiset; the instance with the most chests known), training split (battle % 5 != 0)
carrier_quotas.imputation: an unlinked member wears each effect at its weapon's rate among linked members (style x band, else band, else every band, at >= 20 linked members; else the band's rate over every weapon); counts exact (Poisson-binomial), no sampling
